tools.name: get_2luv_info
tools.description: Returns a concise public summary of 2luv, its main pages, supported public flows, and safety rules for agents.

locale.description: Optional 2luv locale such as en, pt, es, fr, de, zh, zh-tw, ar, ms, ja, ru, or ko.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Returns public 2luv contact and support information, including localized support page links.

locale.description: Optional 2luv locale such as en, pt, es, fr, de, zh, zh-tw, ar, ms, ja, ru, or ko.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Returns public frequently asked questions available on the current 2luv page or locale.

locale.description: Optional 2luv locale such as en, pt, es, fr, de, zh, zh-tw, ar, ms, ja, ru, or ko.

topic.description: Optional FAQ topic filter such as pricing, privacy, contact, letters, cards, or payments.

tools.name: get_legal_info
tools.description: Returns public links and summaries for 2luv privacy, terms, cookies, copyright, DMCA, and consolidated legal PDF resources.

locale.description: Optional 2luv locale such as en, pt, es, fr, de, zh, zh-tw, ar, ms, ja, ru, or ko.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns current public 2luv pricing for a requested region when available. Brazil uses BRL and Pix support; other supported regions usually use Stripe checkout.

locale.description: Optional 2luv locale such as en, pt, es, fr, de, zh, zh-tw, ar, ms, ja, ru, or ko.

region.description: Optional supported 2luv region code such as BR, US, EU, GB, CA, AU, JP, KR, HK, MX, AR, CO, PE, CL, GT, BO, CR, HN, PH, ID, MY, SG, VN, TH, MM, IN, PK, BD, NP, EG, SA, AE, DZ, MA, ZA, NG, KE, or TR.

letterId.description: Optional letter id for follow-up bundle pricing when the page context has one.

tools.name: get_public_feedback
tools.description: Returns all sanitized public 2luv letter feedback visible through the API. Items may include a sanitized display name only; they never include email, phone, links, recipient name, or private letter content.

locale.description: Optional 2luv locale such as en, pt, es, fr, de, zh, zh-tw, ar, ms, ja, ru, or ko.

limit.description: Maximum number of public feedback items to return.

tools.name: get_public_resources
tools.description: Returns public 2luv machine-readable and legal resource links.
